file-newi: mobile-default-simlimit: EditorState.newDocument() without a template stores simlimit=256 (Mobile default, 2cd60d48, #157); Evolution's plain template stores 1000. File > New with the Evolution template is compared by creation-defaults
project-loadLogisim: embedded-library: Mobile copies the library's circuits into the project (marked logisim-mobile-library-id) instead of a relative file# reference, so documents stay self-contained on Android and iOS
project-revertAppearance: evolution-noop: RevertAppearanceAction in d58a61e0 only records the drawing (setDefaultAppearance is commented out since 6dce9c7f8); Mobile restores the default appearance
state:sim-log.defaultSignals: empty-selection: Evolution's Logging window starts with the top-level clock, pins and loggable components; Mobile's trace panel starts empty and offers the same signals
state:sim-tickFreq.choices: frequency-menu: Mobile's Simulate menu offers 1-64 Hz; the Simulation options panel accepts any positive frequency
state:sim-ticksEnabled.period_ms: timer-resolution: Mobile schedules automatic ticks in whole milliseconds (16 ms at 64 Hz), Evolution in nanoseconds (15.625 ms)
